evidence.quote: 4. Physical organization and missing local operations
evidence.range_scope: Whole unchanged supplied ROOT receiver-clearance/rough-contact force-port note; no new Capital proof audit, source-original recovery or hidden-activity inference.

requires: Twelve groups at R32mm, exact opposed preload, Fn>=0 and Fn/100N+|Ft|/250N+|Mxy|/10Nm<=1, plus independent signed10N normal/10N shear/.25Nm bending self envelopes. At each declared point-force port,0<=inward s<=150N,|t|<=.5s,n<=.7s,n>=-100N are REQUIRED introduced laws, not asperity measurements. Known opposite-pair removal, normal allocation A^T(AA^T)^-1 and equal net shear with balanced geometry. Unknown contact moments, material/capacity/error/state/hold dynamics remain physical construction requirements.

assumptions: Continuous scope comes from support functions of explicit convex sets, not a finite-angle reliability or dynamic threshold. Exact pair symmetry, known disabled pair and the local cone are assumptions, not observations. Thirty installed tips are not thirty engaged tips; gamma and8N capacity must be qualified. Tile-only geometry supplies no complete support, sensor, latch, ring, tendon or route. A finite contact patch is not an actual moment-free point-force port. No full rough-surface100N/250N/10Nm device, autonomy, life, service advantage, novelty or all-design obstruction.

Introduced force capacities, preload matching, minimum engagement and load sharing are not measured tips, field instrumentation, material maps or a quote. Actual small-perching and maker source exposures remain limited; unseen images, later text and held originals are not recovered.
contract.units: Source-reported finite chemical, transport, financial, mechanical and measurement quantities at their stated assumptions; no Capital scientific execution.
obstruction: Construct actual load-bearing force ports with bounded local moments, engaged-tip/load-sharing observations, surface/asperity capacity, stiff passive retention, independent load transfer and safe deactivation/retrieval. Include frame, pressure/normal pads, creep, damage, sensor error, preload balance, outages, reset and full costs; qualify the whole operation on declared surfaces against competent mechanisms.

review.scope: Whole supplied original available derivations at exact stated scope; reported numerical execution is not physical qualification, a supplier quotation, novelty, an integrated invention or a new independent Capital audit.
